messages:
Rhea Kapoor: Heads-up: ran a quick assistive tech sweep on the Models list pagination + export dialog. Found three nits: pagination buttons announce just 'button', export dialog doesn't trap focus consistently, and the chart interaction (legend toggles) isn't keyboard reachable.
Owen Blake: thanks Rhea. Which AT did you test with?
Rhea Kapoor: VoiceOver (mac), NVDA+Chrome on Windows, and TalkBack on Android. Pagination issue repros on all.
Marta Ruiz: for pagination labels we should include aria-labels like 'Page 2 of 12' and for prev/next include 'Previous page' and 'Next page'. Also add aria-current="page" on the active page button.
Devon Brooks: agree. Also ensure the page list is inside a nav with aria-label="Pagination" and use a list (<ul>) for semantics. Screen readers then have context.
a11y-bot: automated-check: pagination buttons missing aria-current, localised strings missing for tooltip, focus outline <3px flagged.
Rhea Kapoor: export dialog: when opened, focus sometimes lands on the background or the close button, and tab can escape to the page under the modal if using keyboard quickly.
Owen Blake: modal should set inert on the background and trap focus; we use the modal-root portal. Maybe our focus-trap lib isn't initialized until after animation ends. Add early focus management: set focus to modal container tabindex=-1 immediately after mount.
Marta Ruiz: and set aria-modal="true" role="dialog" and aria-labelledby pointing to the dialog title. For export progress, use aria-live="polite" inside the modal to announce status updates instead of changing document.title.
Devon Brooks: good call. Also add keydown handler for Escape to close modal and restore focus to the original trigger (export button). Save the trigger id in state before opening.
Rhea Kapoor: chart legend toggles: users expect to tab to legend items and press space/enter to toggle series. Currently only clickable with mouse.
Owen Blake: make legend items focusable (tabindex=0 or buttons) and add aria-pressed to indicate on/off. Also expose role="toolbar" or role="group" with aria-label="Chart legend" so screen readers know it's interactive.
Marta Ruiz: for complex charts we may need an offscreen table summary or data table accessible via a 'View data' link with role="button" to open a data table dialog. That helps non-visual users access the numbers.
a11y-bot: suggestion: include keyboard shortcut hint in tooltip: "Press Space to toggle" for legend items.
Devon Brooks: i'll prototype: update pagination markup, add aria-current, wrap in <nav aria-label>, fix modal focus-trap timing (focus modal container on mount), add aria-live region for export progress, make legend items buttons with aria-pressed, and add a hidden data table link.
Rhea Kapoor: nice. Can you also add unit/e2e tests: 1) cypress: open export modal, tab through, assert no focus escape and focus returns to trigger after close; 2) axe snapshot for pagination after aria attrs.
Owen Blake: and add Storybook examples: keyboard demo for chart legend and modal accessible states. We'll run axe/pa11y in CI for those stories.
Marta Ruiz: copy tweak: pagination aria-label should read localized pattern "Page {current} of {total}". Avoid screen-reader-only text that duplicates visible labels.
Devon Brooks: will open a draft PR with changes + test plan. Attaching small js snippets in PR for modal focus and legend toggle.
Rhea Kapoor: thanks team. Assigning to @Devon for the patch. Please ping when PR is up so we can schedule quick AT pass. :thumbsup:
